name: Malaxmi AI Integration Strategy
one_liner: A comprehensive AI backbone and vertical-specific playbooks for Malaxmi Group's diverse business units.
description: This strategy outlines a group-wide AI backbone designed to unify knowledge, automate document intelligence, provide a shared digital assistant, and establish governance. It also includes per-vertical playbooks tailored for property development, infrastructure/EPC, hospitality, logistics/food park, and energy sectors, leveraging AI for various operational tasks.
